summary: The reader's current page is the page on screen, not the next page entering the 800 px pre-render margin; '附本页图' and the thumbnail highlight now use the page the reader shows.

budget_impact.rationale: Which page image is attached changes, not whether or how many: the switch still attaches one page image per question. No new model call, network or stored data change.
budget_impact.before: current page = last page entering the pre-render margin (often the next page)
budget_impact.after: current page = page across the middle of the view, else the most visible one

open_risks: Checked in Chromium on a synthetic 8-page PDF, not in WebKit (the macOS app engine) or on a real paper.
